selector-class-pattern.message: Class names must be snake_case with single underscores and start with the du_ prefix (e.g. du_button, du_button_icon, du_button_primary). No __, --, camelCase, or kebab-case.

scss/dollar-variable-pattern.message: SCSS variables must be snake_case with single underscores.

scss/at-mixin-pattern.message: Mixins are snake_case with the du_ prefix (e.g. du_border, du_focus).

keyframes-name-pattern.message: Keyframe names are snake_case with the du_ prefix (e.g. du_spinner_spin).
